presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional proposal to supply chairs: the proposal reaches B; B's response travels back to A; the supplied milestone comes last, so the clock's hand reaches its mark at the last row and every event lies before the rule. The tracer ends on the clock, which swells.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a garden-services proposal between different parties with all five events. The proposal's receipt and the reply's sending are supplied with one position (shown across B's lane at one time coordinate, order to be examined); the supplied milestone falls between the reply's sending and its receipt, so the rule crosses the diagram mid-way. A supplied sequence link joins the proposal and the reply; the tracer follows proposer → proposal → reply → proposer with the reply in focus.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, element labels, relation captions, references and time labels, three terms and all five events (the milestone between the proposal's receipt and the reply's sending). Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0454.presets.precap.json. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered (layout verdict, text px, smallest rendered head): quantity term 12 -> 38 characters and delivery term 13 -> 39: at 1:1 the taller proposal card no longer fits on either side of the milestone's rule (cards, rule:text). Milestone time label 25 -> 35: at 1:1 the two communication captions find no clear place (cap1, cap3) and the smallest layout drops the portraits to 40.6 px. With every capped field restored: 1:1 has no layout (rows, cap1, cap2; heads 29.0 px). Every other field (names, element labels, relation captions, references, title, item term, the other time labels) is not capped; every capped value stays longer than baseline (the milestone label 25 against 24; one more character in any of the forms tried — "Day 3, 17:30h (fictional)", "Day 3, 11:11 h (fictional)", "Day 3 at 17:30 (fictional)" — wraps its chip and fails 1:1 as above); every count is kept. Shipped: 16:9 18 px, heads 56.2 px; 9:16 18 px, 62.6 px; 1:1 16.1 px, 56.0 px (rendered).
